description: Per-segment dubbing settings. Only used on dubbing tracks. Fields that are not listed here are ignored by `PUT`.

volume.description: Gain of this segment's dubbing audio, from 0 (mute) to 2 (double)

stability.description: Voice stability of this segment, from 0 to 1. Lower values give a more varied, expressive delivery, higher values a more even one. Overrides the speaker's setting for this segment. Only providers that support it use it (ElevenLabs); others ignore it. A value outside 0–1 is rejected with `400`.

similarity.description: How closely this segment follows the voice it clones, from 0 to 1. Higher values stay closer to the original voice, which can also reproduce its accent. Overrides the speaker's setting for this segment. Only providers that support it use it (ElevenLabs); others ignore it. A value outside 0–1 is rejected with `400`.

needsRedub.description: True when the text changed after the audio of this segment was generated

ttsDuration.description: Duration of the generated audio in seconds. Returned by `GET`; accepted and ignored on `PUT`, so a `GET` response can be sent back unchanged.

originalTtsDuration.description: Duration of the audio before it was fitted to the segment, in seconds. Returned by `GET`; ignored on `PUT`.

estimatedTtsDuration.description: Estimated audio duration before synthesis, in seconds. Returned by `GET`; ignored on `PUT`.

ttsEstimationError.description: Difference between the estimate and the generated audio. Returned by `GET`; ignored on `PUT`.
